notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level — DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as every other UK region in this pipeline.

Single agency (National Rail), single mode (train). No light rail, no metro, no buses. Island Line excluded entirely (out-mode, Wightlink FastCat ferry dependency — see published-network.json excludedServices), not catalogued here in any form.

TWO-HUB architecture, not a single hub-lock and not full flat multi-group: Southampton Central stands alone; Portsmouth Harbour is the east-side hub with Portsmouth & Southsea as a secondary board on the same corridor (West-of-England hub+secondary-hub pattern, reused for the Portsmouth side only — Southampton has no comparable secondary-station candidate). Southampton Central and the Portsmouth pair are independent of each other — do not merge.

No doNotGroup needed at any of the three boards — report gives no evidence of separate platform/boarding-section logic per operator at Southampton Central, Portsmouth Harbour, or Portsmouth & Southsea (unlike London Bridge/Liverpool Street in london-se-national-rail).

CRS codes (SOU, PMH, PMS, FAR, ESL, WSB, WAT) are carried from the oracle report's tables and are NOT verified against a live GTFS dump or Darwin response — crsVerified: false throughout, confirm before relying on them for a live board.

Fareham and Eastleigh are catalogued flat as through-running junctions, not stationGroups — no internal hub significance per the report. Westbury and Waterloo are catalogued flat as boundary-only through-running stations (West of England and London & South East National Rail respectively) — not merge points, D2 de-dup concern for whichever region's adapter is wired second, consistent with both those regions' own already-merged packs.
